# Third-party GLB assets

All imported starter assets in this folder are by Quaternius and are listed as Public Domain (CC0) on Poly Pizza.

- `orc-enemy.glb` - Orc Enemy, animated monster miniature

  - License: Public Domain (CC0)

  - License: Public Domain (CC0)
- `crate.glb` - Crate, tabletop scenery prop
